name: VyOS
description: Open source network operating system for routers and firewalls based on Debian GNU/Linux. Supports running in Docker containers for testing and packet routing.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Docker directory exists at /docker/. VyOS requires an IPv6-enabled Docker network. Documented Docker container deployment in official docs.

eval_notes: Full router/firewall OS in a container. Supports containerlab integration. Rich CLI with commit/rollback model makes it excellent for configuration management evaluations. Full-featured router/firewall OS. Docker image via vyos/vyos-build. Also available via ravens/docker-vyos and Aminiok/vyos-docker community containers. Supports BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, VRRP, IPsec, OpenVPN, WireGuard.
